title: Hearty Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A sour and tender Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made keto-friendly with careful ingredient selection, and served with a unique ice cream topping, all cooked to perfection in a traditional tagine pot with beurre-monte for added richness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, beurre-monte, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Transfer the lamb and marinade to a traditional tagine pot or a heavy Dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid.
Cover the pot and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb hot, topped with a scoop of keto ice cream.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
